title: minimapcluster
summary: MSUI's minimap cluster (Program.Minimap.cs) carries the reference chrome and most behaviors: UI-Minimap-Border top band + round border, zone text, minimap show/hide toggle button that keeps the chrome alive, zoom in/out buttons plus wheel zoom, aura-driven tracking icon in MiniMap-TrackingBorder with right-click cancel, unread-mail icon (INV_Letter_15 + tracking border) off the pending-mail flag, party dots, tracked-resource dots, and the player arrow. Several reference polish laws are absent.

openItems.text: Zone text is always gold - no PVP-type tinting (friendly green / hostile red / contested orange) and no zone hover tooltip with the territory line
Zoom buttons never grey at bounds (reference disables ZoomIn at max, ZoomOut at 0) and play no igMiniMapZoomIn/Out sounds
Minimap toggle plays no igMiniMapOpen/Close sounds
Mail icon has no 'You have unread mail' hover tooltip
No day/night indicator, minimap ping, or battlefield/meeting-stone buttons (Benilla also scopes these out)
